cohort: 86,260 women hospitalized for delivery at Magee-Womens Hospital, Pittsburgh, PA between 2003 and 2012
finding: Overweight and obesity, maternal age ≥35 years, preexisting hypertension, excessive gestational weight gain, and lack of a college degree were significantly associated with severe maternal morbidity, with population attributable fractions ranging from 4.5% to 13%.
